author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: Presence Manager combines your phones' Hubitat mobile app presence, an optional network check per person, and optional third-party services such as Google Home or SmartThings into one reliable Home/Away status for the whole household. It is built to avoid the common problem where a single unreliable signal briefly drops out and your automations behave as though everyone had left, when other evidence clearly shows someone is still home. Track up to 10 people individually, cover visitors with Guest Mode, see hours at home per person per day over a rolling 90 days with CSV export, and check exactly which evidence produced the current decision on the built-in diagnostics page. The output drives either its own switch or an existing switch or presence device, so it plugs straight into Rule Machine and dashboards. This release fixes an issue where changing a person's presence sensor was not saved correctly, and reduces the load the app places on your hub.
